projects.name: cjm-python-decompose-core
projects.summary: A Python source-code decomposition core for context graphs: parses .py modules (docstrings, imports, and the symbol tree of functions/classes/methods with their calls) into provenance-carrying graph nodes and edges that co-reside with the markdown source-type. First source = the ecosystem's own code; generalizes to any Python corpus.

projects.name: cjm-notebook-decompose-core
projects.summary: A Jupyter/nbdev notebook decomposition core for context graphs: a notebook IS a CodeModule whose authored source is an ordered sequence of VERBATIM cells (the lossless source substrate), composing the python decomposer (code cells -> symbols) and the markdown decomposer (markdown cells -> prose) with interleaving edges. The first step toward graph-as-source-of-truth (notebook -> graph).

projects.name: cjm-markdown-decompose-core
projects.summary: A Markdown decomposition core for context graphs: parses Markdown content (frontmatter, structure, and [[wiki-links]]) into provenance-carrying graph nodes and edges. First source = the ecosystem's own memory/decision files; generalizes to any Markdown corpus.

projects.name: cjm-harness-transcripts
